profile_name: Stay engaged ON — opt-in, not shipped
description: Enables FIX_STAY_ENGAGED: an engaged unit that would fall back by default (off its objectives, or on one where leaving does not change who controls it) compares staying engaged with falling back on one points ledger (points per wound, the T7-24 rule) and stays (REMAIN_STATIONARY) when staying is worth STAY_ENGAGED_MIN_MARGIN more. STAY: the damage it deals in our own Fight phase and a wipe bonus; the strike-back, cut by our first casualties times the chance we strike first (11e 12.04: never when the enemy has Fights First and we do not; Resolve Remaining Combats starts with the player who did not make the last Fights First pick, so our own chargers this turn (Fights First, 11.04) can hand the enemy the first pick; separate combats in one step share the alternating picks); close-quarters shooting for a MONSTER/VEHICLE (10.06); a phase-plan lock target kept from shooting next turn, or an objective holder / action performer pinned (04.02, 09.07, 16.01); the enemy shooting it avoids while engaged (04.02; 17.03 + errata for a MONSTER/VEHICLE); the T7-27 'hold' survival recommendation. LEAVE, priced on the fall-back generator's own destinations: Fall Back and Shoot / Charge value, an objective the fall back would take (14.02), the engaged enemy freed as a target for our other guns (04.02), Desperate Escape hazard and battle-shock rolls when battle-shocked, forced by an enemy rule (Commentary 09.07.01) or when the way out crosses enemy models where the engine refuses an Ordered Retreat through them (EA-08; until then a crossing costs nothing), and the T7-27 'fall_back' recommendation. NOT the shipped default (ships at 0); this is the arm to load for the fire gate / paired A/B, and what tests/scenarios/sp/ai_stay_engaged.json loads. Fire tag: '[FIX_STAY_ENGAGED] <unit> engaged_choice old=fall_back new=stay stay=<pts> leave=<pts> top=<term>'. Exam: tests/exams/mv08_stay_engaged_to_finish.json.
